cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-preserves-native-editing-state
cases.purpose: Enabling/configuring/disabling UI editing preserves multiline Unicode text, native keymaps, completion, point, selection, modification state and undo.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-placeholder-never-becomes-text
cases.purpose: An empty hint never becomes copied or submitted text; only text mutations notify and disabling detaches the observer.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-replacement-is-undoable-and-coalesced
cases.purpose: External replacements produce a final-value event and one undoable edit, while equal values preserve edit state silently.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-stale-update-preserves-edit-then-undo
cases.purpose: A delayed update cannot erase newer edits even when undo has restored the original text; a current tick permits replacement.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-copy-narrowing-and-read-only
cases.purpose: Exported text is detached and property-free across narrowing; read-only blocks typing while explicit updates remain possible.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-observer-failure-preserves-accepted-text
cases.purpose: Observer errors propagate without deleting accepted text; reentrant replacement is rejected without overwriting the edit.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-configuration-is-validated-before-change
cases.purpose: Invalid settings do not detach the installed observer, and invalid editor handles, text and ticks are rejected.

cases.name: etaf-ui-editor-instance-and-mode-lifecycle
cases.purpose: Independent editors do not share callbacks or content; changing major mode and killing a buffer retire their behavior.

cases.name: etaf-ui-tile-grid-controls-coordinates-and-retains-neighbors
cases.purpose: Coordinate callbacks activate the correct tile; local color/text writes preserve neighboring Host identity and geometry.

cases.name: etaf-ui-tile-grid-read-only-and-invalid-input
cases.purpose: Read-only grids expose no activation callbacks and reject invalid dimensions, callback types and overflowing labels before publication.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-registry-replaces-removes-and-validates
cases.purpose: Icon registrations round-trip and replace specifications, reject invalid replacements atomically, and remove their own name/glyph inventory.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-lookup-distinguishes-missing-name-and-set
cases.purpose: Partial maps resolve names through the requested/default style, preserve the provided inventory, show unknown names, and reject unknown styles.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-svg-unavailable-has-printable-text-properties
cases.purpose: SVG-unavailable rendering preserves the documented printable ASCII variant, text-property paint and default minimum width.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-renders-without-a-default-face-font
cases.purpose: An icon row keeps its one-line height contract when a graphical frame reports no resolved default face font instead of failing in font-info.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-box-keeps-two-rows-width-and-full-target
cases.purpose: Mounted icons occupy exactly two rows when requested, preserve minimum width and presentation props, and dispatch a callback from the whole Host.

cases.name: etaf-ui-toggle-icon-switches-glyph-and-paint-through-value
cases.purpose: A reactive toggle value switches the icon glyph and its paint in place while the box keeps its declared geometry, role and help text.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-metrics-estimates-fit-without-gui
cases.purpose: Batch-safe metrics distinguish fitting from oversized declarations without requiring installed fonts or a graphical frame.

cases.name: etaf-ui-icon-validates-box-and-supports-registered-draw
cases.purpose: Applications can add a draw-function SVG style entirely through registration; invalid sizing and callback props fail before rendering.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-registers-track-and-fill-hosts
cases.purpose: A mounted Range registers the Track and Fill Hosts that retained updates address.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-fill-moves-through-retained-geometry
cases.purpose: A caller grows the Fill through ETAF's retained geometry update without publishing a new View.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-press-reports-change-and-commit
cases.purpose: A pointer click reports the pointed value through on-change and on-commit in that order.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-drag-reports-live-values-and-commits-on-release
cases.purpose: Dragging reports intermediate values, commits the released value and ignores a cancelled gesture.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-snaps-to-the-step-and-clamps-the-ends
cases.purpose: Pointer values snap to :step and never escape :min..:max.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-disabled-rejects-pointer-events
cases.purpose: A disabled Range dispatches no callback and rejects pointer events.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-reactive-bound-reproportions-in-place
cases.purpose: A reactive :max bound re-proportions the Fill without a Component re-render.

cases.name: etaf-ui-range-validates-its-input
cases.purpose: Invalid numeric props fail before the Range paints.

cases.name: etaf-ui-prepared-resize-keeps-window-chrome-and-input
cases.purpose: Controlled catalog window sizes retain title, eight handles, button targets, source snapshots and fresh-render output through prepared publication.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-resize-example-uses-controlled-handles
cases.purpose: The public catalog resize example updates controlled geometry and restores the original rectangle on cancellation.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-chrome-uses-macos-traffic-lights
cases.purpose: Window chrome exposes left-positioned red, yellow and green controlled actions.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-controls-is-reusable-and-grouped
cases.purpose: Traffic-light controls are independently reusable and share an explicit hover group.

cases.name: etaf-ui-taskbar-and-workspace-bar-publish-controlled-actions
cases.purpose: Desktop navigation bars expose accessible controls whose selection remains caller-owned.

cases.name: etaf-ui-desktop-bars-follow-selection-and-status-sources
cases.purpose: Ref and computed bar inputs update selection and status while retaining accessible input targets and supporting pure rendering.

cases.name: etaf-ui-workspace-status-keeps-trailing-actions-visible
cases.purpose: Short, long, multiline and empty status values preserve a single-row region, full trailing labels and working action targets.

cases.name: etaf-ui-workspace-layout-label-updates-as-prepared-text
cases.purpose: A ref or computed layout label changes the control text within its fixed width while the runtime generation, bar geometry and action target stay retained.

cases.name: etaf-ui-launcher-and-switcher-remain-controlled
cases.purpose: Launcher and switcher visibility, selection and dismissal remain controlled by the caller.

cases.name: etaf-ui-splitter-projects-named-panes-and-divider
cases.purpose: Splitter renders named panes and a keyboard-focusable divider that forwards gestures.

cases.name: etaf-ui-splitter-overlay-uses-caller-rectangle
cases.purpose: An overlay splitter uses an exact caller-owned divider rectangle and forwards drag gestures.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-keeps-geometry-and-mode-controlled
cases.purpose: Window geometry remains caller-owned while controlled mode changes only the projected content.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-forwards-chrome-and-resize-gestures
cases.purpose: Title-bar and resize-handle gestures reach caller callbacks with their edge and phase payloads.

cases.name: etaf-ui-resize-lock-confirms-every-edge-and-corner
cases.purpose: All eight Window and standalone Panel handles accept locked resize at the confirming press and ignore subsequent motion and release positions.

cases.name: etaf-ui-resize-lock-cancels-and-releases-active-targets
cases.purpose: Escape cancels each locked resize handle once, clears active state and preserves the following command.

cases.name: etaf-ui-resize-lock-nil-keeps-ordinary-release
cases.purpose: Explicit nil and the standalone Panel default keep resize gestures ending at the first release.

cases.name: etaf-ui-resize-lock-rejects-invalid-modifier
cases.purpose: Invalid lock modifiers are rejected through the public Component validation contract.

cases.name: etaf-ui-resizable-panel-rejects-unknown-edge
cases.purpose: Resizable panels reject unsupported edge names at the public Component boundary.

cases.name: etaf-ui-label-supports-box-geometry-and-text-presentation
cases.purpose: Label width, padding, border, wrapping and inherited text presentation match direct Ebox composition.

cases.name: etaf-ui-label-reflows-reactive-text-and-preserves-following-content
cases.purpose: Reactive English and Chinese text reflow inside the allocated width, preserving the Label ref and following content after resize.

cases.name: etaf-ui-button-callback-uses-only-committed-props
cases.purpose: A later sibling failure cannot replace the live Button callback.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-columns-require-unique-non-nil-keys
cases.purpose: Reject ambiguous column identity with its index and offending key.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-stateless-table-keeps-pure-render-support
cases.purpose: Automatic row references do not introduce setup state into plain Tables.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-factory-rejects-ref-and-watch-creation
cases.purpose: A factory cannot allocate persistent state or subscriptions during render.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-row-and-column-reorder-retain-state
cases.purpose: Counter state follows row and column keys, with one cleanup on deletion.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-grid-reorders-without-remounting-cells

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-duplicate-field-migration-retains-distinct-state
cases.purpose: Name and Uppercase read the same field but retain distinct column identities.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-later-factory-error-retains-committed-handler
cases.purpose: A failed later cell cannot replace an earlier cell's committed callback.

cases.name: etaf-ui-cell-grid-publishes-current-rows-and-selection

cases.name: etaf-ui-docs-readmes-mount-and-dispatch-in-fresh-emacs
cases.purpose: Both catalog READMEs use real names and complete mounted interactions.

cases.name: etaf-ui-pagination-wraps-complete-controls-in-narrow-space
cases.purpose: A narrow allocation wraps whole controls without clipping page text.

cases.name: etaf-ui-pagination-keeps-explicit-colors-and-semantic-defaults
cases.purpose: Explicit colors remain effective without replacing omitted variant defaults.

cases.name: etaf-ui-adaptive-columns-reject-invalid-fractional-weights
cases.purpose: Invalid fractional tracks identify the offending column before mounting.

cases.name: etaf-ui-adaptive-cells-retain-identity-and-failed-candidates
cases.purpose: Adaptive row/column reorders preserve local state and rollback ownership.

cases.name: etaf-ui-table-string-column-keys-read-equal-alist-keys
cases.purpose: Table and DataGrid read string keys in both fixed and adaptive cells.

cases.name: etaf-ui-button-use-behavior-dispatches-through-host
cases.purpose: Install Button `:use' Behavior and dispatch its merged callback.

cases.name: etaf-ui-number-input-validates-and-emits-value
cases.purpose: Prompt-backed number input owns bounds and emits the accepted value.

cases.name: etaf-ui-number-input-stays-inline-in-a-wrapping-row
cases.purpose: A number input nested in another wrapping row keeps its steppers and value on one line.

cases.name: etaf-ui-button-disabled-preserves-explicit-theme-surface
cases.purpose: A disabled Button keeps explicit dark presentation props in its surface.

cases.name: etaf-ui-pagination-is-readable-and-boundary-safe
cases.purpose: Pagination renders labeled controls, stable refs, and page boundaries.

cases.name: etaf-ui-pagination-composes-inside-a-grid-track
cases.purpose: Pagination must distribute free space inside its assigned Grid track.

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-grid-keeps-long-cells-on-one-line
cases.purpose: Long tabular values use an ellipsis instead of increasing row height.

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-grid-converts-character-columns-and-keeps-air

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-grid-rejects-nil-row-ref

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-grid-projects-loading-error-and-empty
cases.purpose: Project the Data Controller loading, error, and empty states.

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-grid-requires-stable-row-key
cases.purpose: Reject a DataGrid that cannot identify retained rows.

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-grid-rejects-nil-row-key
cases.purpose: Reject a DataGrid row-key function that returns no identity.

cases.name: etaf-ui-checkbox-binding-shares-the-callers-ref
cases.purpose: Bound and explicit checkboxes observe one ref with additive events, disabled protection and unmount cleanup.

cases.name: etaf-ui-binding-retargets-only-after-successful-publication
cases.purpose: Binding target changes publish atomically; conflicts preserve committed callbacks and explicit nil remains valid.

cases.name: etaf-ui-number-binding-validates-cancel-and-disabled-input
cases.purpose: A bound number input writes accepted integers and preserves its ref after cancellation, invalid or disabled input.

cases.name: etaf-ui-bindings-report-conflicting-or-read-only-inputs
cases.purpose: Conflicts and invalid binding targets report contextual component input errors.

cases.name: etaf-ui-data-controls-render-async-refresh-and-cancellation
cases.purpose: Pending reads/writes, cancellation and failure retain accepted rows and actions with valid focus.

cases.name: etaf-ui-select-maps-labels-to-controlled-values
cases.purpose: Selection preserves nil values, handles cancellation and disables empty lists.

cases.name: etaf-ui-native-inputs-report-invalid-props-in-context
cases.purpose: Invalid values, options and bindings identify the Component and property.

cases.name: etaf-ui-menu-selects-enabled-actions-and-returns-focus

cases.name: etaf-ui-control-forwards-native-feedback
cases.purpose: Native root attributes reach Ebox through the public Button component.

cases.name: etaf-ui-grid-and-table-share-row-presentation
cases.purpose: Table and DataGrid produce matching layout and selection paint while all row fields remain business data.

cases.name: etaf-ui-grid-rows-use-framework-identity-and-callbacks

cases.name: etaf-ui-number-input-validates-configuration-and-live-value
cases.purpose: NumberInput validates configuration before publishing inputs and follows caller-owned integer values through native editing.

cases.name: etaf-ui-dropdown-opens-navigates-selects-and-restores-focus

cases.name: etaf-ui-dialog-composes-slots-and-blocks-covered-controls

cases.name: etaf-ui-dialog-compact-height-keeps-one-row-header
cases.purpose: A bounded compact dialog keeps its title to one row while preserving background content.

cases.name: etaf-ui-floating-surfaces-nest-and-release-buffer-shortcuts
cases.purpose: A menu inside a dialog restores the dialog keys, then the buffer's keys.

cases.name: etaf-ui-popover-keeps-instance-state-and-independent-open-inputs
cases.purpose: Two controlled popovers have independent state and clean up their slots.

cases.name: etaf-ui-nested-dialog-covers-parent-and-restores-its-controls
cases.purpose: A nested modal blocks the outer panel and restores it on close.

cases.name: etaf-ui-unpainted-popover-does-not-capture-keys
cases.purpose: An unavailable anchor leaves the mounted buffer's ordinary keys usable.

cases.name: etaf-ui-surfaces-example-composes-menu-dialog-and-input
cases.purpose: The runnable example hands menu focus to a dialog and back to its trigger.

cases.name: etaf-ui-gallery-mounts-composed-catalog-and-opens-tooltip
cases.purpose: The integrated Gallery mounts catalog categories and toggles a controlled tooltip.

cases.name: etaf-ui-feedback-and-navigation-render-public-contracts
cases.purpose: Feedback and navigation Components render and dispatch through public refs.

cases.name: etaf-ui-selection-components-render-public-contracts
cases.purpose: Radio, Segmented, Switch and Slider render controlled values through the public DSL.

cases.name: etaf-ui-drawer-composes-both-sides-and-restores-focus
cases.purpose: Both modal drawer edges retain caller-owned values, compose footer actions, dismiss and restore the opener.

cases.name: etaf-ui-composition-components-reject-invalid-props

cases.purpose: DatePicker, Tree, Calendar and CommandPalette compose shared public input, navigation and floating-surface contracts.

cases.name: etaf-ui-composition-components-render-public-contracts
cases.purpose: Tag, Kbd, Steps and List compose through public props and caller-owned selection callbacks.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-reactive-geometry-preserves-content-and-input
cases.purpose: Reactive position, dimensions and layering preserve nested control values and input ownership.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-controls-react-to-active-paint-and-retain-targets

cases.purpose: Taskbar selection, traffic lights, stacking and variable status publish together with fresh-render parity and detached snapshots.

cases.name: etaf-ui-prepared-focus-rejection-keeps-accepted-ui-until-retry
cases.purpose: A rejected coordinated focus update preserves accepted UI, then publishes the requested appearance on retry.

cases.name: etaf-ui-focus-scalar-props-preserve-renderable-snapshots
cases.purpose: Controlled scalar props preserve matching rendered controls, canonical snapshots and fresh-mount appearance across focus changes.

cases.name: etaf-ui-window-fonts-inherit-and-override-independently
cases.purpose: Window titles, controls, labels, buttons, inputs and footer inherit parent typography; title/body overrides are independent.

cases.name: etaf-ui-panel-font-default-follows-buffer-face
cases.purpose: An unspecified panel size leaves Emacs default font height intact and an explicit family reaches rendered content.

cases.name: etaf-ui-control-markers-keep-native-selection-behavior
cases.purpose: Checkbox, Switch and Radio ASCII marks preserve full labels and controlled values across native Return activation.

cases.name: etaf-ui-traffic-lights-use-one-cell-ascii-without-svg

cases.name: etaf-ui-text-input-cancel-restores-the-activation-value
cases.purpose: Cancelling restores the value captured at activation through the change callback.

cases.purpose: Disabled fields refuse activation and read-only fields stay focusable without opening a session.
